items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Well, of course, the ones that I played with, I think I've already mentioned, like Bill Gillen and Bill Padron and Abbey Brunas. Let's see, Brent Bowman.

ctx.x: Who were some of the great cornet players around town when we were on the subject of cornet players too? What do you remember when you were young?
Well, of course, the ones that I played with, I think I've already mentioned, like Bill Gillen and Bill Padron and Abbey Brunas. Let's see, Brent Bowman.
Do you have any particular favorite out of them?
